mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.ConsttUnrcordSesnMapper.selectCombo1List : 통합기관 LIST */ AA.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , AA.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , AA.INST_NO AS INST_NO , '4' AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /** 기관유형구분코드 사이버상담(4) **/ FROM SAA300 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INST_NO = '371' /** 청소년사이버상담센터 **/

WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{instNo} AS INST_NO , TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS START_DATE , TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1 AS END_DATE FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.ConsttUnrcordSesnMapper.selectUnrecordSesnList : 상담자별 미기록 회기 LIST */ AA.INST_NM , BB.USER_ID , MAX(C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.FLNM_ENCPT)) AS FLNM , COUNT(*) AS CCNT FROM SAA000 AA /* 통합기관 */ , SAA200 BB /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 CC /* 종사자 */ , AYB200 DD /* 채팅이력 */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.INST_NO = ZZ.INST_NO
AND CC.OGDP_INST_NO = AA.INST_NO AND CC.ENFSN_NO = BB.ENFSN_NO AND DD.CYSNET_ESNTAL_NO IS NULL
AND DD.CHTT_BGNG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND DD.CHTT_BGNG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND BB.USER_ID = DD.CNSLTNT_ID GROUP BY AA.INST_NM , BB.USER_ID ORDER BY AA.INST_NM , BB.USER_ID
